cohort: Women with CHD aged 18-45 years between 1992 and 2004 in Quebec, Canada
finding: This study found that pregnancy and delivery rates in women with CHD increased significantly over the study period, and that cesarean sections were associated with increased postpartum cardiac hospitalization.
mod_finding: The increment in cesarean section rates was more pronounced among women with CHD than among the general population, and cesarean sections were associated with increased postpartum cardiac hospitalization.
